# Settlement Solicitors

> Settlement Solicitors is a trading style of Ackroyd Legal (London) LLP, an SRA-regulated law firm. We give specialist employment law advice on settlement agreements, redundancy, and employment tribunal claims for employees and employers across England and Wales, with a free initial consultation.

## Core services
- [Settlement agreements](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/settlement-agreements/): Advice on settlement agreements, terms and negotiation for employees and employers.
- [Redundancy](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/redundancy/): Redundancy rights, process and entitlements.
- [Employment claims](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/employment-claims/): Unfair dismissal, constructive dismissal, discrimination and tribunal claims.
  - [Unfair dismissal](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/unfair-dismissal/): Fair and automatically unfair dismissal, tribunal process, compensation.
  - [Constructive dismissal](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/constructive-dismissal/): Resigning over employer conduct, fundamental breach of contract.
  - [Discrimination claims](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/discrimination-claims/): Equality Act 2010 claims, protected characteristics, uncapped compensation.
  - [Whistleblowing](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/whistleblowing/): Protected disclosure claims, dismissal and detriment, no qualifying period.
- [Restrictive covenants](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/restrictive-covenants/): Non-compete, non-solicitation and non-dealing clause advice for employees and employers.
- [TUPE](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/tupe/): Business transfer, outsourcing and service provision change advice for employees and employers.
- [Employer services](https://www.settlementsolicitors.com/employer-services/): Settlement and employment advice for employers.
